annotations.rationale: This disease-related phrase is used adjectivally to modify the head noun "phenotype" rather than serving as the disease mention head itself, so it is annotated as a Modifier.

annotations.rationale: This is a referential mention of the specific disorder whose prevalence is being discussed. The full contiguous span is retained because the parenthetical abbreviation interrupts the disease name in the text.
annotations.guideline_section: What to Annotate §1 (Specific Disease vs Disease Class); §5 (minimum necessary span)
